summary.text: Garlin Gilchrist is the Democratic nominee for Michigan Secretary of State and has been lieutenant governor since 2019. A computer engineer by training, he left the race for governor in January 2026 to run for this office, and is campaigning on protecting voter data from federal access, campaign-finance transparency and better Secretary of State branch services.

paragraphs.text: Gilchrist is a computer engineer by training; according to his official state biography he is a software engineer.
In 2017 he ran unsuccessfully for Detroit city clerk against incumbent Janice Winfrey.
He has been lieutenant governor since 2019, serving alongside Gov. Gretchen Whitmer.
In January 2026 Gilchrist dropped out of the race for governor and entered the Secretary of State race.
Michigan Democrats chose him as their nominee for secretary of state at the party's convention on April 19, 2026.
His state biography says he lives in Detroit with his wife and children.
